tracker_comparison: Same YOLO26n repeat-1 raw boxes and scores for ByteTrack / TrackTrack ReID OFF / ON. No re-detection or threshold tuning.
detector_comparison: YOLO26n 640 FP16, RF-DETR Small native 512, DEIMv2-S native 640, same ByteTrack and counting rule; practical model presets, not compute-matched or architecture-only comparison.
event_agreement: One-to-one clip/direction/time matching against existing source-only AI review windows. Identity is not verified by this automatic match. Primary original intervals, secondary intervals expanded by 0.5 seconds. Both retained.
timing: CUDA synchronized calls. Warm-up and initialization separate. Pipeline processing includes source read, detection, tracking, counting and telemetry; excludes rendering/video export. Cached tracker timing excludes detection and must not be compared as full pipeline FPS.
ground_truth: 14 existing AI source-review events. No human-consensus annotations, full-frame boxes, persistent reference IDs or masks. Do not calculate HOTA/IDF1/person recall/segmentation accuracy from proxy counts.
selection: Report counts, event temporal agreement, duplicate/fragmented-ID observations, full-frame videos and cost. Do not select a winner from fewer unique predicted IDs alone. No tuning using these evaluation clips.
